Expanding Access to Expert Care
We are a compassionate, experienced team dedicated to caring for pets facing a cancer diagnosis. We understand how overwhelming this time can feel, and our focus is always on clear guidance, quality of life, and delivering the highest level of care for your pet.
Proudly serving the Greater Houston area and The Woodlands, with a new location now open at the Texas Medical Center to provide even more convenient access for families and referring veterinarians.

About Our Woodlands Location
Welcome to our newest location in The Woodlands which was designed with a special intent to provide oncologic veterinary care with additional amenities for pet owners, we strive to provide the highest level of care possible while improving your pet’s quality of life during their treatment journey.
Uniquely, we are the first and only specialty referral hospital in the Houston area dedicated to patients and clients with cancer. We are a young, rapidly growing practice, and in a short time, we have exceeded expectations in providing excellence in patient care and referral services to clients and veterinarians in the Greater Houston area.   As a result, we are answering the demand for expended full-time specialty care as part of our expertise in The Woodlands and Greater Houston area.  We have a detail-oriented group of fun-loving technicians that excel in client communication, patient care, and empathy.
The Woodlands, Texas was voted one of the best places to live in the USA!  and is 40 minutes north of Houston.
This location offers advanced diagnostic tools and treatments, including:
128-Slice CT Scanner
Internal Medicine
Surgery
Kind words from our clients…..
Today is a day we will never forget. 💛
Bailey finished her very last round of chemotherapy today.
There truly aren’t enough words to express how grateful we are. To the incredible team at The Woodlands Animal Cancer and Referral Center   thank you for your compassion, your expertise, and the love you showed Bailey every step of the way. You gave us hope on the hardest days.
To everyone who stood beside us during this journey…whether emotionally, financially, or spiritually ..thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Every message, every prayer, every bit of support carried us through more than you know.
Bailey has fought so hard, and today we celebrate her strength, her spirit, and this huge milestone. 🐾✨
Here’s to healing, to hope, and to many more happy days ahead. 💕
Anonymous
Pet Owner
It is with gratitude that I type this review, we were blessed to have worked closely with Dr. Carlos Souza, Dr. Katie Kaiser, Dzidzielia, Aaliyah, and Jenny, they are phenomenal professionals. Our beloved puppy was diagnosed with cancer and required a delicate removal of her spleen, a 7lb mass had grown on it, and her surgery was successful thanks to Dr. Souza, his expertise, and team. Although we couldn’t beat the cancer as it had already metastasized, and the first round of chemo didn’t work either, it did allow us to enjoy our recovered and happy pup for about 3 more months post-op. During this time extension as we like to call it, we bundled so many more memories with her, more walks to the parks, treats, hugs, kisses, videos, photos, laughter, etc.
We are happy to have taken Lana to Animal Cancer & Referral Center. They gave us a beautiful extension with her, and the treatment we all received was quick, kind, and resourceful to help us make the best decisions for Lana’s diagnosis.
Debbie V.
Pet Owner
After receiving a devastating misdiagnosis elsewhere, we turned to this facility for a second and final opinion on our fur baby’s cancer. From the very beginning, the staff showed compassion, professionalism, and genuine care for our situation. They didn’t just treat our pet, they supported us as a family going through something incredibly difficult.
Despite us living 4 hours away, the team went out of their way to accommodate our schedule. Dr. Souza was not only incredibly skilled successfully removing the tumor with no complications but also kind and communicative. They stayed in touch regularly to check on our baby’s recovery, which meant the world to us.
Thanks to this incredible team, our fur baby is now cancer free. We are forever grateful to this facility for giving our beloved companion a second chance at life. If you’re looking for skilled, compassionate, and truly dedicated professionals, this is the place you want to go.
Dr. Souza, thank you so much for saving my fur baby’s life, I thank God everyday for putting you on our paths.
Maria N.
Pet Owner
Thank you Dr. Souza, Dr. Kaiser, Dr. Robinson, Shelby, Crystal, Tabatha, Cayla, Amanda, Catherine, Jenny, Cristina, and anyone else involved in Jack’s care. We thank you for giving our 3 year old son a chance. He enjoyed every day like it was his last. If you have a pet dealing with Cancer, this is where you should go. They listen to you and will try to help your pet beat cancer. They are honest and let you know your pets chances before you begin treating cancer to help you make your decision. Sorry Jack peed on the dog library sticks but it was a sweet memory of him while he was alive. Such a stinker! I highly recommend this place without reservation.
Jennifer B.
Pet Owner
No one ever hopes to go to a place like this. Period. But if you are in the situation where you need compassionate care and knowledgeable staff I can highly recommend this practice. Dr Christopher Robinson was incredibly kind and extremely well versed in oncology. His demeanor is perfect for delivering a difficult message. The facility is welcoming peaceful. Toys and treats for the pets and Kleenex, snacks warm drinks for parents. The consultation rooms are warm and comfortable. All of the staff are kind and respectful. Although it’s not good news for our dog, we got the data that we needed to make the difficult decision and I am forever grateful.
Noreen A.
Pet Owner
I recently brought my dog, Stella, to Dr. Parsons. She and the staff here are amazing! Excellent at what they do with great communication and customer service. You can feel they all care, and Dr. Parson’s bedside manner is exceptional. I have been to a quite a few veterinarians and specialists and I must say Pearland Animal Cancer & Referral Center is hands down THE best. I found them online and decided to get a referral here because of their great reviews and they did not disappoint. I drive all the way down from The Woodlands, but it is worth it. I am super excited because they have another location opening in The Woodlands 🙂 Highly recommend!!
Susan M
Pet Owner

Trust
We believe trust is the foundation of our relationship with pet owners. We are committed to earning your trust by providing exceptional veterinary care and open communication throughout your pet’s treatment journey.

EMpathy
We know that empathy can make all the difference in a pet’s recovery journey. That’s why we approach every case with sensitivity, compassion, and an unwavering commitment to providing personalized care.

Expertise
Expertise goes beyond book knowledge or technical skills; it also requires experience working with pets facing complex medical conditions like cancer. At the Animal Cancer and Referral Center, our team has years of experience treating pets with cancer using advanced diagnostic tools and comprehensive treatment plans tailored to each patient’s needs.

HOPE
At the Animal Cancer and Referral Center, we believe that hope is a vital element in the journey towards healing. Our compassionate team works tirelessly to provide cutting-edge treatments and personalized care plans for your cherished pets. We understand the emotional weight that comes with a cancer diagnosis, and we strive to offer a beacon of hope through our commitment to innovative therapies and unwavering support. By placing your trust in our expertise and dedication, you can rest assured that we will stand by your side, working together to give your companions the best possible chance for the best outcomes in their cancer diagnosis.
